title: Training GPT-3 on one GPU takes 288 years
summary: A paper estimates 288 years to train GPT-3 on one GPU, and 34 days on 1,024 newer GPUs.

beats.say: One graphics card would need two hundred eighty eight years.
That is the estimate for training G.P.T. three on a single chip.
beats.cap: Training GPT-3 on a single chip

beats.say: The model has a hundred seventy five billion parameters.
It trained on three hundred billion tokens of text.
Two hundred eighty eight years is over one hundred five thousand days.
Spread the job over one thousand twenty four newer chips.
The same training run takes thirty four days.
That is roughly three thousand times faster.
The model did not change. The hardware and the count did.
Scale turned nearly three centuries into thirty four days.

claims.note: Megatron-LM paper, introduction: training GPT-3 with 175 billion parameters 'would require approximately 288 years with a single V100 NVIDIA GPU'
same sentence names the V100 for the single-GPU estimate
Section 5.1 names the A100 for the cluster estimate
Section 5.1: 1024 A100 GPUs, batch size 1536, 140 teraFLOP/s per GPU; the paper gives 34 days for GPT-3
Section 5.1: trained on T = 300 billion tokens
GPT-3 paper abstract: 'an autoregressive language model with 175 billion parameters'

youtube.hook: One V100 GPU would need about 288 years to train GPT-3. A cluster of 1,024 A100 GPUs would need 34 days, by the estimates in the Megatron-LM paper.

instagram.caption: One GPU: 288 years. 1,024 GPUs: 34 days. Same model, GPT-3.
